instruments.name: Octave Pulse Lead
instruments.description: A 12.5% pulse lead doubled by a quiet triangle an octave below for extra weight.

instruments.name: Finger Bass
instruments.description: A round electric bass played with the fingers, a little growl over a solid fundamental, for band and pop parts.

instruments.name: Sub Bass
instruments.description: A deep sine with a gentle lowpass sweep, felt more than heard under the rest of the mix.

instruments.name: Drawbar Organ
instruments.description: Sine and triangle stops an octave below, at, and above the note, held steady like a tonewheel organ.

instruments.name: Electro (808)
instruments.description: The 808 drum machine of electro and early hip-hop: a booming kick, snappy snare, clap, rimshot, choking hats, toms, cowbell, congas, claves, and maracas on the General MIDI drum notes.
